title: Euclid × SPT-3G 6×2pt
author: Cail Daley
description: The SPT × Euclid 6×2pt key-project paper for SPT-3G: the overlap, the TR1 analysis and first blinded posteriors, the covariance plans and the data products needed from SPT, open questions, Euclid external-collaborator access, and DR2.

sections.title: Opening
sections.outline: The SPT × Euclid 6×2pt paper, for SPT-3G.

sections.title: SPT × Euclid
sections.outline: The overlap with Euclid, the Euclid–SPT MoU project, the DR1 timeline, the CMBX key projects and the KP2-3 papers, the SPT × Euclid paper among them.

sections.title: The TR1 analysis and where it goes
sections.outline: The pipeline, its validation on GLASS mocks, Muir-style blinding, the blinded TR1 × SPT-3G data vector, the first blinded posteriors, where SPT-3G is tighter than ACT DR6, and Euclid DR2's overlap with SPT-3G.

sections.title: The covariance plans
sections.outline: The FLASK mock covariance, not yet in the pipeline; the ways to put SPT-3G and the other CMB surveys in it; the FLASK covariance itself.

sections.title: Taking part
sections.outline: The open questions, and Euclid external-collaborator status.

sections.title: Backup
sections.outline: The data products needed from SPT, the systematics-template crosses, and the FLASK mean spectra.
